title: Schedule Ii Fax Exceptions
rule_summary: Federal law provides specific circumstances in which a faxed Schedule II prescription may serve as the original, including prescriptions for LTCF residents, qualifying Schedule II narcotics for hospice patients, and qualifying Schedule II narcotics compounded for specified direct parenteral or infusion administration.
exam_relevance: Tests a distinct pharmacist decision path using current official authority rather than rote trivia.
verification_notes: Authoring-session current official-source verification on 2026-08-14; requires fresh independent audit before release.
